html:
Local Jewelry Buyer Leads

CaratBase connects independent jewelers with local people looking to sell gold, get appraisals, or buy engagement rings. The first 3 leads are free, then $40 per accepted lead.

What you get

First 3 leads free; $40 per accepted lead; optional Pro website widget for $12/month

Why CaratBase

CaratBase is starting in Atlanta and plans to expand to more metros.

FAQ

How much does it cost? The first 3 leads are free. After that, each accepted lead costs $40. A Pro website widget is optional at $12/month.

Can I cancel the Pro widget at any time? Yes. The Pro widget can be cancelled whenever, and it drops back to the free version.

Next Step

Learn more at caratbase.com.
